title: CprResult
description: Nucleos -> Arbor. What relief was computed, and on what basis.

CprVerificationStatus.title: CprVerificationStatus
CprVerificationStatus.description:
Whether the claimed carbon price was verified.

NON-BLOCKING but it MUST travel. An unverified relief claim is still payable and still reduces the liability, so refusing to return it would be wrong — but presenting it in the UI as though it were verified would be worse. Arbor's trust-display rules forbid confident styling on uncertain data, and this flag is what drives that.

relief_amount.description: The relief after conversion, free allocations, rebates and the cap.

exchange_rate.description: Rate applied. Travels with the result so the figure can be reproduced without knowing which rate table was live at the time.

capped.description: True when the relief was limited to the CBAM liability. Relief never exceeds the charge it offsets.

scheme_qualifying.description: Whether the scheme is on the qualifying list for this jurisdiction.
